Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the certification and recertification of health care facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to certification and recertification of health carefacilities; and adding a new section to chapter 43.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The federal government requires Washington health care facilitiesto be certified in order to receive federal health care programreimbursement. The department receives funding from the federalgovernment to perform the certifications and recertifications of thesehealth care facilities. When the federal government does not providesufficient funding to cover all certifications and recertifications,the secretary may either assess fees on certification andrecertification applicants or receive state appropriations to fund thecertifications and recertifications.
